en.name: Ballistic Armor Co. Bastion helmet (French Woodland)
en.description: The Bastion NIJ level IIIA tactical helmet designed for law enforcement and civilian use. Equipped with M-LOK interface rails for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Ballistic Armor Co. French Woodland version.
